lessons.title: Telling my story
lessons.en:
Anna: Ben, this summer journey was wonderful!
Ben: Yes. The mountain, the beach, and the city — what fun memories!
Anna: I wrote everything in my diary.
Ben: Let's share the photos with the class.
Anna: Thank you, Ben, for travelling with me.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，这个夏天的旅程太棒了！
本：是的，山、海滩、城市——多么美好的回忆！
安娜：我都写到日记里了。
本：我们和班里同学分享照片吧。
安娜：谢谢你，本，陪我一起旅行。

lessons.title: My summer journey
lessons.en: My summer journey was full of wonderful moments. We climbed mountains, swam in the sea, and made friends with kids from another city. I learned to ask the way in English and pay for souvenirs by myself. My diary has fifty pages of stories now. I will share them with my classmates. A journey is the best teacher, and thank you, summer!
lessons.cn: 我的夏日旅程满是精彩瞬间。我们爬山、游海、与外地小伙伴交朋友。我学会用英语问路、自己付钱买纪念品。日记已经写了五十页故事。我要和同学分享。旅行是最好的老师，谢谢你，夏天！
